content:
Scientific Concept: Einstein's Theory of Relativity
Domain: physics / relativity
Definition: Physical theories establishing spacetime geometry: Special Relativity unifies space and time via constant c, and General Relativity describes gravity as spacetime curvature.

Principles:
Principle of Relativity: Laws of physics are invariant across all inertial frames.
Constancy of the Speed of Light: Speed of light c in vacuum is constant regardless of motion of source or observer.
Equivalence Principle: Inertial mass and gravitational mass are identical; local acceleration is indistinguishable from gravitational field.
Einstein Field Equations: Spacetime curvature determined by stress-energy tensor: G_munu + Lambda g_munu = (8pi G / c^4) T_munu

Experimental Proofs:
Eddington 1919 solar eclipse observation of gravitational deflection of starlight
Pound-Rebka gravitational redshift experiment (1959)
LIGO direct detection of gravitational waves from binary black hole merger GW150914 (2015)
Atomic clock time dilation verification on GPS satellites (38 microseconds/day net drift)

Applications:
GPS satellite constellation time synchronization
Astrophysical modeling
Cosmology
